entrance.name: Breach in the curtain wall
entrance.look: Where the curtain wall has fallen a stairway of tumbled stone climbs into the outer ward.

do.say: By day it is only a ruin. That is what makes it worse.

interact.look: A crenel of the old battlement, brought down by frost and a few hundred winters. Under it, in the snow, the print of a boot.
A roof beam, sound at its heart. It would split into stakes.
interact.take_text: I split a length from the sound heart of the beam. Ash would be better, but the Count will not mind what it was cut from.

interact.look: Rotted through, and hanging by one hinge. Behind it nothing but dust, and the smell of old earth, and a draught that moves where no draught should.
Broken-axled and snowed under. Four black horses once stood before it. Harker told me of the driver, and of his eyes.
A leather pouch, stiff with frost, dropped by one of the Szgany in their flight.
interact.take_text: Three cartridges, dry in their paper. Whoever dropped them ran in a great hurry.

interact.look: A shaving glass, set against the wall by some hand long gone. I look in it and see myself plainly, an old man with a cold. I am more glad of that than I can say.
Ashes, a gnawed bone, boot-prints leading to the gate.

do.say: A fire, and not two days old. They camped here and left at a run, leaving the gate open behind them. Whoever guards this place does it from within.
